method: Saved MuseumStart Play Mode. Shared baseline runner lifecycle and queued synthetic controller/HMD/keyboard states, ordinary Dynamic Input System updates through production Input Actions and XR ray selection. API drag fixtures identified separately. No direct SelectEnter/Exit, InputSystem.Update, scene saves or generation.
limitations: No real headset/controller, comfort, reachability study, user test or executable build validation. RenderTexture images are diagnostic views of the product scene, not headset screenshots. Direct physical hand interaction is not independently validated by this runner.
